summary: This Form 6-K reports the results of shareholder meetings held by Wellchange Holdings Co Ltd on July 6, 2026. The meetings approved a reduction in par value, an increase in authorized share capital, and a consolidation of Class A shares, along with an increase in voting rights for Class B shares. These are routine capital structure adjustments and governance changes, not a transformative event. The filing does not involve an acquisition, tender offer, activist campaign, or any other special situation. No deal terms, break fees, or premiums are discussed. There is no risk-arb angle; the changes are purely administrative and internal.
